// diagnostic

E0112

This value has a type that does not fit the argument, print, or interpolation site

What

This value has a type that does not fit the argument, print, or interpolation site

Why

Jet checks each use so a call cannot receive or render the wrong type

Fix

Use a value of the expected type, or convert it before passing or interpolating it

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0112: tests/ui/E0112_int_from_float_brace.stderr.

Error [jet.ValueTypeMismatch]: `3.7` isn't a whole number, so `Int` can't hold it exactly
  --> tests/ui/E0112_int_from_float_brace.jet:2:12
    |
  2 |     n: Int{3.7}
    |            ^^^
 Why: An integer typed literal converts a Float only when no rounding is needed; it never picks a rounding for you
 Fix: Round it first, as in `Int{math.trunc(value)}`, or with `math.floor`, `math.ceil`, `math.round` or `math.round_even`
